1. unhoped for, unlooked for , [variant datesTragica Adespota, etc.; τὸ ἀνέλπιστον τοῦ βεβαίου the hopelessness of security, (Thucydides) 
2. active, 
3. of persons, having no hope, hopeless , (Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus); with infinitive having no hope or not expecting that . . , (Thucydides) 
4. of things or conditions, leaving no hope, hopeless, desperate , (Sophocles Tragicus); τὸ ἀνέλπιστον despair ,…

1. unquestioned, impossible to be questioned or refuted , of statements or arguments, (Thucydides); ἀν. ἔχει τὸ ἀνδρεῖον leaves their courage without proof , (Thucydides) 
2. of persons, not to be convicted, irreproachable , (Xenophon Historicus), etc. (ML)

1. without hearing , of the dead, (Moschus Bucolicus) 
2. with genitive not hearing a thing, never having heard it, ignorant of it, (Xenophon Historicus), etc.:—;absolute, σκαιὸς καὶ ἀν. ignorant , (Demosthenes Orator) (ML)
